balls.text: And Kuldeep gets DC past 200! Goes across the stumps and manages to sweep this between backward square and short fine leg for the only boundary off this 20th over! And now GT need 204 to win!

Taken at long-on! On a length outside off and spinning away, Ashutosh frees his hands and looks to go down the ground. Gets it off the toe end and it goes straight to the fielder in the deep. What an excellent over this, considering the field restrictions and that it is his first over of the game! Sai Kishore, you beauty!
Tossed full outside off, Ashutosh sweeps it wide of long-on. The fielder scrambles and stops the ball but doesn't collect it at first go, so they get the brace with ease
Sai Kishore tries to get cheeky but messes up his line here as he fires this down leg for a wide
This is full and angled across Starc, who pushes it out behind point and gets Ashutosh back on strike
Tossed wide again, but Ashutosh fetches it with a sweep to long-on. They take the single this time
Throws it wide of off, Ahutosh flat bats it down to long-off. No single taken though!

That loops up behind the batter and Buttler backtracks and takes it. Titans appeal, but the umpire says that went off his shoulder! And Titans don't have a review left! Banged in short, Ashutosh went for the pull and missed. Ashutosh points to his shoulder as well, but Ishant is not happy with that explanation. Ashutosh also pull up his sleeve to show where the ball hit him! Replays confirm Ashutosh was being honest there!
Ashutosh walks down the crease and Ishant retorts with a short ball. But it's too short and Ashutosh can't reach it even as he looks to play it well above his head. Called wide
Low full toss angled across Starc, who drives it out to point's left. The fielder can't stop it immediately and they get a single easily

Caught at cover! Off a full toss! And DC's Impact Player falls for 1 off 3!. It's a low full toss and Ferreira doesn't get enough elevation on that. Sai Kishore contributes in this innings with a good catch above his head. And DC's decision looks even odder now
Full toss on leg, flicked away to deep backward square on the bounce
Low full toss outside off, driven out to cover for a single
Starts with a yorker around leg that Ashutosh is able to whip out to the leg side
Another full toss, but angling into Ashutosh, he is able to squeeze it out in front of point and gets a single. An excellent spell from Prasidh Krishna comes to an end
Ramp goes all the way! Ashutosh is denting Prasidh's figures now! 140kph bumper outside off, he just sways back and ramps it over the keeper for back-to-back sixes
Oh, that's a poor ball! It's a low full toss going down leg, and Ashutosh just helps it on its way over fine leg. Goes into the stands!
Fires this full ball down leg
Back of length around off and seaming in, he looks to work it leg side and misses and that pops to the vacant short third region off his pads

What a screamer from Buttler and Prasidh has four! And he is on a hat-trick! This is back of length on middle, following Vipraj, who only pokes at it. The ball flies to Buttler's right and Buttler also flies to his right to grab that one-handed! What a match Prasidh is having, what a season Prasidh is having!

And Prasidh makes an impact! On a full length around leg, 138kph, Axar backs away to slap it down the ground but all he manages is a thick outside edge and Buttler does the rest. A third wicket for Prasidh today and that makes him the season's leading wicket-taker!

Goes through the fielder for four! Siraj bowled an excellent over until now, and this could also have been just a single at most, but Ashutosh ensures DC stay above the 10 RPO mark. This is full outside off, Ashutosh caresses it to the cover fielder's left. He couldn't get down in time to stop that
Full around leg, 142kph, Axar makes room and looks to hit this down the ground. Goes to long-on on the bounce
Short outside off, Ashutosh hits a tennis forearm shot down the ground to long-on
Right in the blockhole! And Axar does well to jam his bat down on that to keep it out to the off side
Misses his line by a mile! That almost landed outside the strip! Looks to take it away from Axar's arc, but that slipped out of his hand I suppose
Low full toss, Ashutosh works it between deep midwicket and long-on

Rashid drops another one! Axar slaps this full ball down the ground, but it's not straight enough of Rashid at extra cover. He does well to move to his left and get low, but the ball pops out of his hands as he makes contact with the ground!
Put away with ease! Short ball angled across him and Ashutosh nails the pull over square leg

Costly misfield! Ashutosh goes across to this full ball on off to paddle it fine, it goes to Prasidh's right at short fine leg and he lets it slip through his hands. But in more bad news, Prasidh - arguably GT's best bowler on the night - is also down with what looks like cramps
Edge just falls short of Buttler! On a length around leg and finishing outside off, Ashutotsh pokes at it and goes off his gloves and doesn't carry to the keeper!
Short outside off, it seams in. Axar looks to pull it away and it goes to deep square leg on the bounce
Full and angled across Ashutosh, driven out to long-off
Looks for the slower yorker, it comes off as a low full toss. Axar looks to whip it leg side and gets an inside edge to short fine leg
Length ball angled across, Axar slaps it down the ground to long-off. 150 up for DC. They had got to 100 in nine overs. 50 runs in the next six
Short outside off, Ashutosh sways back to ramp and gets it to deep third on the bounce. Ashutosh only managed to get an edge on that
Short of good length around leg, Axar looks to whip it off his hips but misses. Goes towards point off his pads and they sneak a leg bye
Siraj welcomes Ashutosh with a yorker around leg. Ashutosh manages to keep it out

Stubbs, what have you done? He shaped to reverse scoop that and Siraj bowls a yorker around leg, cramping the batter. All Stubbs manages is to lob it to Prasidh at short third. Timeout brings a wicket! Stubbs was looking really good out there

Full around leg, Stubbs looks to work it leg side and misses. Siraj appeals as the ball pops back towards him off the pads. But that looked like it was going down leg. In fact, replays show impact itself would have been outside leg

Rashid thinks that's caught behind! Gujarat Titans review. This is sliding down leg and Axar looks to clip it fine. There was a noise as it goes past him before Buttler collected. Axar signals, after the review, that it hit his thigh pad. And that's what the UltraEdge confirms. Another wicketless day for Rashid Khan
Salt in the wound for Rashid! On a length around leg, Axar swings across the line and sends it flying over square leg. 50 partnership up in 33 balls
Stubbs skies it but Rashid can't hold on! Stubbs takes on this ball full outside off, with Rashid giving it some air. Gets a top edge and Rashid sprints back but just misjudges it!
And that is massive! Tossed up in the slot on off, Stubbs clears his front leg and hoists it over cow corner!
Tossed full outside leg, Axar gets legside of it and looks to hit it down the ground. Can't get a hold of that and it goes to long-on after a couple of bounces
Legbreak on a length on off, Stubbs works it through midwicket
Short and going across him, Axar cuts it hard, but straight to the point fielder
Full outside off, eased to long-on for a single
Lovely drive! This is in the slot outside off and Stubbs hits it aerially, but wide enough of mid-off and finds the boundary. Hold the pose, Tristan!
Back of length outside off, Stubbs makes room and slaps it aerially to deep point's left. They run two
Length ball outside leg, Axar looks to nudge it fine but misses. Goes off his body to long leg's left and they get a leg bye
On a length around off, Stubbs comes down the track and eases a drive to deep cover
Now Rashid runs in starting from the other side of the umpire, and darts it full. Stubbs tucks it away through midwicket
On a length on middle and going on with the angle, Axar pulls it along the carpet to deep midwicket
Floated full on off, driven down to long-off
On a length around off, he cuts it behind point for a single
Lofted down the ground! Handsome stroke, that! This is flighted too full on off, Axar just takes a big step with his front foot and hits a lofted drive straight of long-off
Googly on a length outside off, Stubbs tucks it through midwicket for a single
Pitched up on leg, Stubbs pushes it down the ground to long-on
On a length around leg, Axar backs away and cuts it to deep third's left
Full around off, pace off, and Stubbs eases it down the ground to long-on
Very full around middle, pushed back to the bowler. Ishant is getting the ball to swing a bit, even halfway into the innings!
Full outside off, hint of swing away, and Stubbs firmly drives it to the cover fielder's left. They ease their way to two runs as the deep point fielder runs across
Pitched up outside off, Axar drives it down to long-off
Goes back to the length ball and nudges it through midwicket for a couple
Full on leg, clipped through midwicket

A celabrappeal from Rashid, not given! He is adamant it is out but has it pitched outside leg? GT review. Flights it more, lands it fuller, Axar looks to slog it across teh line but misses it completely. Hits him on the back leg that is in front of leg. But the ball pitches jusssst outside leg, GT lose a review
Tossed up full outside off, driven through wide mid-off
Fuller and wider outside off, eased down to long-off
Just outside off on a length, gets a thick edge on the cut to short third
Shorter and slanting away, he glides it to deep third to bring up DC's hundred
Fuller on middle, driven down to long-on
Shot! Full and outside off, Stubbs leans into it and drives it through extra cover. It was bowled at 146.9kph and it went away at double the speed
Bouncer outside off, 141.7kph, he ducks, called wide
Hard length around off, he stands tall and defends it towards backward point

Prasidh wins the second duel with another Karnataka team-mate! Nair picks out deep third. Shortish and just outside off, 142.1kph, Nair backs away again to steer/ramp it over third, ends up not middling it and Arshad takes a few steps to his left to take it reverse-cupped. Big wicket and the extra over to PK works for GT
Bashed over cover! Length ball outside off at 141.8kph, Nair backs away and smacks it over the off side, not off the meat of the blade but enough to get it away from sweeper cover
Quicker and on a length outside off, it is the legbreak, he wrists it through mid-on
Short and spinning in, he pulls it towards deep midwicket where Siraj dives and saves two
Floated full on leg, he nudges it to the on side and sprints to the other end, beating Rashid's throw at the bowler's end
Drags it down on a length on leg, once again looks to sweep but gets it off the inner half to fine leg
Full on leg, clipped through square leg
Low full toss on off, swept through square leg
Slashes hard and gets four. Prasidh goes around thee wicket and bowls it full outside off, Axar gets down on a knee, leans into it and hits it well over backward point
Slightly fuller on middle and leg, punched down to long-on
Chipped back towards the non-striker off the length ball
Full and angling in on leg, clipped to dee square leg
Banged in short, almost took Axar by surprise. Not in control of the pull towards fine leg
Length ball on middle, punched down to long-on
Length ball slanting away, patted towards backward point for a quick one, 14 off the last over of the powerplay, DC are rocketing away
Whipped away in fine fashion! Gentle attack. Length ball on off and middle, Nair moves to off and picks it up over deep square leg
Smartly done! Backs away and uses Arshad's pace. It is on a length but outside leg, Nair makes room and just guides it between short third and backward point
Length ball around off and middle, punched towards mid-off for a quick run

Dropped but a very tough chance. Gill rushes to his right from mid-off and dived with his right hand out but it did not stick. Axar backed away to go over the off side but it got big on him and almost brought about his downfall
Full and swinging in on off, driven back to the bowler
Zip and lift from a shortish length outside off, Nair feels for it and is beaten
Back of a length angling away, steered to deep third, superb start from Prasidh this

Huge appeal and given! Prasidh nails the yorker and Rahul's toes! He wins the first Karnataka duel. Nair perhaps asks Rahul to review it but he doesn't and walks back. It swings away a bit late and misses Rahul's attempted flick and strikes him flush on the back foot. Nothing would have saved KLR there, and that's a top seed from PK
Spots him back away and follows him with a short ball, he pulls but misses
Length ball just outside off, he steers it wide of short third and picks up two as SRK has to chase it from deep backward point
Greeted with a boundary! Length ball angling in, straying on the pads. Rahul gets inside the line and flicks it wide of short fine leg and well away from deep square leg
Length ball on leg, clipped to deep backward square leg
Full and slanting away, Rahul smacks another four! Clears his front leg and slices it over cover, wide enough of Rashid running from deep backward point to bring up DC's fifty
Oh, easy peasy! Hardly looked like any power on it. Length ball on the pad, Rahul wrists it through the vacant fine leg region
Length ball on middle, taps it in front of midwicket and sprints to the other end
Length ball on middle, he goes back and punches it through point
Length ball angling away, he clears his front leg and looks to slash it through off but misses

Now Nair backs away and bags six! This is more of the form that he showed against MI. Backs away to the back of the length ball and slashes it hard over deep backward point, 17 off the over and DC race away
Full on off and middle, driven back to Siraj, 142.5kph
Short ball angling in, doesn't connect the pull well and it rolls through square leg
Authoritative, audacious, KLassy! This is right in Rahul's slot, on a length on offf, looked like the offcutter. He clears his front leg and tonks it high over mid-on

Rahul loses his shape but gets a boundary. Backs away to the length ball in a bid to go over cover but ends up slicing it towards deep point. Sai Kishore covers good ground to his right from deep third and dives but doesn't get near
Length ball slanting in on off, he stands tall and looks to tap and run, gets a thick inside edge onto his back leg
Full and angling away, almost a yorker, Nair looks to dig it out with an open face but misses. Half an appeal from GT but nothing there. Eight runs and a wicket from that
Angling away on a length outside off, he leans into it and opens the bat face while punching it to deep point

A wicket out of nowhere! Porel will be kicking himself!!! He hangs his head in dejection before starting the long walk back. It is a juicy full toss just outside off, a bit of shape away in the air. He could have hit it anywhere but slogs it straight to Siraj at mid-on
Full and outside off, charges down to go through the off side but misses. A nice shape away there for Arshad

That made superb sound off the bat. And Prasidh doesn't do well in the deep. Full and wide outside off, swinging away, Porel leans into it and plays the square drive. Looks like Prasidh didn't pick it early, rushed to his left from deep point, slid but parried it away
Swinging in on the pad, fullish, 140.4kph, flicked to deep backward square leg to get going
Full and swinging down leg again, Nair doesn't connect the flick. Both new-ball bowlers starting similarly
Swings it down leg after starting on a length, easier take for Buttler
Full and wide outside off, sliced the drive straight to backward point, where Tewatia makes a diving stop, 16 off the opening over of the game
Timed, uff! Expensive start for Siraj. This is on a length but wide outside off, doesn't shape back in much. Porel leans into it and drives it straight down the ground
On a length on middle, 141.4kph, defended back
Picked up handsomely over the on side! On a length but on the pad, Porel stands still and hits it aerially, keeping deep backward square leg in play for a while

Porel uses his feet and makes contact. Swinging in just a touch from outside off, he clubs it over mid-off. It plugs in the outfield. Prasidh gives it a valiant chase but he was in contact with the boundary cushion while sliding to save it
Length ball in line of the stumps, 135.2kph, he comes forward and defensively hits it back to the bowler
Another one down leg, 142.6kph, swings away again but goes on the bounce to Buttler
Full and swinging down leg, he goes for the flick but doesn't make contact. DC are underway with a wide

Yorker goes through Tewatia as he gets an inside edge and races away for four! Buttler stranded on 97 but he looks thrilled because Gujarat Titans have won this to go top of the table! Not Starc's day, he finishes with an economy of close to 15, but Jos Buttler is the man of the hour with a stunning innings that made this chase never look nervy. Kept 20 overs, came in to bat in the second over of the chase in the searing Ahmedabad heat. Take a bow, Jos! That was stunning!
Tewatia slog-sweeps the first ball for six! Starc misses his length, it turns into a slot ball and that's deposited over deep midwicket! What a shot that was!
On a length outside off, driven out to deep point for the single

Holes out at long-off! Full toss outside off, Rutherford goes across and looks to take it on and he mistimes it to Starc in the deep. Rutherford wants this checked for no-ball on height, but it looks fine! Third umpire does a comprehensive check, and it's all fine. Mukesh Kumar has his man. Rutherford departs seven short of what would have been a maiden IPL fifty
Nails the wide yorker this time. Sneaks under the bat as Rutherford looks to squeeze it out

Yorker outside off, he jams his bat down and drives it down straight. Starc at long-off dives to make the save. And they do well to get two. Buttler is proper knackered in this heat, having also kept in the first innings. What stamina!
Low full toss on off, flicked away to deep midwicket
Goes full and wide again, it's a full toss in the end. But Rutherford moves out to punch it out to deep third
Short and wide, slapped away to deep cover
Top edge clears backward square leg running back! Short and angled across, Rutherford looks to pull and skies it but gets enough on it. Karun Nair racing back can't get there
Short outside off, pace off, Buttler looks to pull but is early into the shot. The ball deflects off the outside edge to his right
Rutherford misses this low full toss as he swings across the line. Goes off his boots towards short fine. Mohit appeals but impact was outside off from the looks of it
Slices this as he goes inside out but it lands safe! Slower ball, full outside off, Buttler went inside out but it drops short of long-off running to his left
Oh, just past the bowler! Just short of yorker length outside off and Buttler has enough room to smash this right back down the ground. Mohit has to get his head out of the way and it races away
Low full toss on off, Buttler drives this down to long-on and he is now just 10 away from a century!
Length ball worked to deep midwicket
Goes for the wide yorker and that's just past the tramline! Wide called immediately
Inside edge onto the pads and it rolls towards point. This was very full around leg and Buttler wanted to heave it leg side
Low full toss outside off, driven square to deep point
Driven down to long-off
Hammered away! On a length on off and Buttler treats the free hit as just that! Hoists this over midwicket!
Goes for that wide yorker, Rutherford moves across the stumps and looks to steer it to the off side but gets it to short third. He fumbles and that allows them a single. And Mukesh has overstepped!
On a length around middle, nudged down the ground to long-on
Full on leg, tucked square for a single
On a length outside off, Buttler looks to hit it down the ground but hits it into the ground and Kuldeep collects to his left
Dropped short and Buttler duly punishes it! Half-tracker on leg and Buttler hammers a pull in the gap at midwicket
Tossed up full on off, driven to cover
Tossed full outside off, nudged down the ground past the bowler's right for a single
Starc stops it being six boundaries in a row! Short of length around leg, Buttler fends and the ball rolls to the off side

Almost a chance! But it's a fifth boundary in a row for Buttler in the end! Starc goes short and Buttler pulls it square. Doesn't hit it nearly as well as he'd want and it drops just short of Vipraj diving forward from deep square leg. He went for the catch, and can't stop it and the ball rolls to the rope
Four in a row! Starc needs to change his plans! This is another yorker, on the stumps this time. But Buttler is up for it, and punches it back down the ground, beating the mid-off fielder
Another yorker put away for four! Angles this across him, Buttler reaches out and gets it too fine for the deep third fielder
Oh, Buttler you beauty! He is so good when he is playing like this! Starc nails the wide yorker, but he jams his bat down with an open face to beat the backward square leg fielder
Superbly played by Buttler! Starc goes for the yorker outside off, maybe just bowls it a tad short of that length, but Buttler bats down and squeezes it away through cover
Another swing and a miss Full outside off and Rutherford can't connect with this slog-sweep
Gets this away for four! Tossed full outside off, Rutherford looks to reverse sweep. And wait, that actually comes off his pads, and beats Rahul to race away
Rutherford loses all shape as he looks to slog-sweep this away. Full ball angled across and it beats the outside edge as the West Indian swings and misses
Full on leg, tucked away through midwicket. They are happy to settle for the single
Vipraj drops his length shorter, Buttler backs away and cuts to point

Smacked down the ground! Very hard to stop Buttler when he gets going, and slot balls won't help at all! Tossed up too full on off, he clears his front leg and lofts it down the ground. One bounce and four
Looks to go wide, but overdoes it. Well outside the wide line
Offcutter on a length outside off, Buttler punches it towards mid-off for a single. 18 off the over!

Drilled past mid-off! And that's the fifty up for Jos Buttler! Too full outside off and Buttler thrashes it away just wide of mid-off. His third half-century of the season and he has set GT up well in the chase
Length ball angled across, Rutherford helps it towards backward point for a quick run
Slower ball on a length around off, Rutherford looks to run it down fine on the off side but picks out short third
That's even bigger! Dug in short on leg, Rutherford swivels and pulls it away over fine leg! 91m that travelled!
Hoicked away! This is just short of good length around off and Rutherford deposits into the stands in front of square!
Legbreak outside off, Rutherford runs it down fine on the off side and short third scrambles to his right to stop that
Rutherford gets a good enough connection! This is overpitched from Kuldeep and Rutherford lofts it over long-off! His bottom hand came off but he got enough power behind that shot
Kuldeep overdoes this as he goes wide of off. Past the tramline and he'll have to bowl that again
Wrong'un on leg, Buttler waits on it and clips it out to deep midwicket
Rutherford works this full ball on middle to long-on
Short and wide, and Buttler can only get it out to Stubbs at deep cover
Legbreak around middle and leg, turning away, and Rutherford tucks it square on the leg side for a single as Rahul goes to his right to collect
Drags this down on middle, going on with the angle, but Buttler can't cash in. Looks to rock back and pull but misses out
Tossed up outside off, Rutherford looks to take this on but doesn't hit it as well as he'd like. Goes off the outer part of the bat to long-off on the bounce
Tossed full on off, driven to cover
Full outside off, he opens his face to run it down to short third
Googly outside off, Buttler works it towards wide long-on
Full toss outside off but Buttler can't take full toll of this. Drives it wide of long-off for a couple
Fuller on middle, knocked down to long-on
Fuller around off, punched to cover
Tossed up around off, it is the wrong'un, he presses forward and pats it to the on side
Reaches out and finds the gap. Quicker length ball wide outside off, Rutherford manages to get it between backward point and short third
Length ball on leg, clipped through midwicket
Tossed up full on leg, flicked through midwicket for a brace
Pushes it across him, he presses forward to defend but is beaten
Shortish on middle, pulled through backward square leg
Massssiveeeee! Another googly just outside off, full enough for Buttler to get under it. Sends it high and long over the sight-screen, 82m
Wider outside off, he lofts it over cover with an open bat face, taking it wide of the fielder in the deep
Length ball on off, punched down to long-off

An ugly swipe and Rutherford gets away! Sees the tossed up ball in his arc, he looks to go big a la Buttler, gets a leading edge towards sweeper cover. Starc comes running in but it lands short of him
Turns back in after landing, he is late in adjusting and punches it down to long-on. Superb start from Kuldeep this
Spins away from a length around off, punched to cover again
The wrong'un on a length on off, punched to cover

Kuldeep gets the main man Sai Sudharsan. Shortish on middle, he goes back to pull and hits it straight to deep midwicket. Not the best ball but DC will take anything that comes their way. No mistake from Stubbs in the deep, Sai Sud looked so good but is not gone
Googly on a length on middle, pushes it through mid-off
Flatter length ball outside off, mistimed towards mid-off
Quicker and on a length on middle and leg, 100kph, clipped through midwicket
Tosses it up outside off, 88.6kph, with a high-arm action, Buttler cuts it wide of deep backward point and gets a brace
Slightly short on middle and leg, pulled through midwicket
Wider length ball, slapped to cover
Quicker and fuller on the pad, 95.9kph, clipped through backward square leg
Slants it away on a length outside off, cuts it over point
Risky run as Sai Sudharsan mistimes the full toss straight to Kuldeep at mid-off. He has a shy at the striker's end but misses
Full outside leg, he punches it to long-on
Follows Buttler who is backing away and spears it full and down leg, he misses the flick
Length ball around off, clipped through midwicket, 50 of the partnership up

Oh my word. Sai Sudharsan is raising the temperature for DC. Mukesh goes around the wicket and bowls it very full outside off, Sai Sud leans forward kneeling down, but transfers his weight back, opens the face of the blade as he jams it past backward point
Hop and smack! Mukesh bangs it in and slants it away from Sai Sudhasan, who jumps and slaps it over cover
Angles it away on a length, he has a swish but misses
Quicker one on a length around off, 92.9kph, punched to cover
Googly on a length on leg, 90.4kph, clipped through square leg
Fires it fuller on off, punched down to long-off
Drags it from outside off and deposits this over long-on! Nigam tosses it wider outside off, doesn't matter for Buttler. Slogs it high and long to bring GT's fifty
Buttler goes high, Buttler goes long! Nicely tossed up on off, he clears his front leg and sends it sailing over the sight-screen. Not one to miss this
Lands it on a length on leg, clipped straight to square leg
Goes back to slap the inspinning length ball but ends up hitting back to Axar off the inner half
Arm ball on a length on off, punched to wide long-off
Quicker length ball outside off, cut straight to backward point
Shortish and Buttler finds the gap. Goes back and opens the bat face on the cut. Was in the air for a bit but it is between backward point and short third
Length ball on leg, nudged through forward square leg
Welcomes Axar with a boundary! Lands it further than good length on leg, Sai Sudharsan gets inside the line and picks up the sweep shot and it goes all the way over fine leg
Length ball down leg, he shapes for the scoop but doesn't connect. Passes down leg and called wide
Ouch, ouch, ouch! Buttler's hurt. And that is not a nice place to get hit - on the box. Shortish ball on leg, he looks to clip it away and gets beaten on the inside
Length ball angling away, 140.3kph, he opens the face of the bat to get it well wide of deep backward point and hares back for two
Length ball just outside off, goes for the punch but gets it off the outer half wide of short third
And this is even better! Sai Sudharsan is getting the GT flags waving in the crowd. This one is fuller than the previous ball, he gets forward and drives it to the left of the cover fielder
Back-to-back fours for GT. Sai Sudharsan has smartly used Starc's pace here. Stands tall to get on his toes and slaps the length ball through point
Over extra cover, just! Full and outside off, not much swing this time around. Buttler does not take his foot towards the line of the ball but drives it aerially over short extra cover
Fuller outside off, driven to mid-off

Mix-up and Gill is out of here! A very poor judgement call and it proves to be the end of the GT captain's stay in the middle. It is a length ball on off and middle, he clips it straight to midwicket and rushes for a single. Sai Sudharsan spotted Nair get to the ball and didn't rush. Nair had all the time in the world to nail the direct hit at the striker's end. Massive wicket
Length ball angling away outside off, cut away past backward point
Fuller outside off, driven straight back at Mukesh, who fumbles and parries it towards mid-on
Easy on the eye, Gill! Shape away from a length outside off, Gill leans into it and times the drive away from the body. This is a ground he loves and it shows
Creamed through cover. Full length ball outside off, Sai Sudharsan comes forward and plays a punchy drive through cover
Digs it into the surface, angling it across Sai Sud after pitching outside leg, he arches back to play the ramp but misses
Fuller and outside off, pushes it with soft hands towards mid-off and sprints to the other end
Length ball outside off, steered to deep third
Length ball slanting away, 140kph, Gill pats it towards point and jogs to the other end
Length ball on middle to start, 141.5kph, a hint of shape away from the left-hander, Sai Sudharsan clipps it in front of square on the leg side and gets going
